audience.description: Adults who treat their cat or dog like family. They plan seasonal photos, share pet moments with friends, and love small, cozy details. They want something soft, easy to wash, and cute enough to post, without a fuss at getting it on the pet.

brief.productRole: The mustard knit beanie and rust-red knit sweater are the costume change in a tiny pet fashion reveal. A cat's ears pop through the two beanie openings, the adjustable strap clicks snug, then a dog wriggles into the sweater, the stretch yarn gives, and the fit settles. A quick wash-cycle shot shows the soft knit coming out fresh. Closing shot shows both pets side by side in their knits.
brief.mood: Cozy, playful, warm, a little mischievous

music.style: Upbeat indie pop with a handclap groove, plucky ukulele, soft glockenspiel, warm bass and a light shaker. Bright, modern, a little whimsical, with a small record-scratch pause on the reveal beat.

visual.look: Stylized 3D animation with a soft stop-motion feel: chunky rounded character models, visible knit stitch texture and fuzzy yarn fibers via subsurface shading, shallow depth of field with a macro lens feel. Warm autumn grade with mustard, rust and cream tones, soft window-light and gentle bounce light. Vertical 9:16 framing with the pets centered at eye level, snappy cuts every 1 to 1.5 seconds, squash and stretch on the pet reactions, and a final held hero frame.

wardrobe.styling: The cat wears the mustard yellow knit beanie with a small pom-pom and ear openings. The dog wears the rust-red knit sweater with a tiny fabric tag showing a simple paw symbol. A third pet, a small dog, wears a plain cream knit bandana. No logos, no text, no brand marks.
